visual_brief: Taipei 101 has blue-green glass, eight stacked outward-flaring sections, circular facade medallions and a tiered crown with a long spire. Elephant Mountain provides the classic skyline viewpoint above Xinyi district. Distinguish it from the nearby rectangular Taipei Nan Shan Plaza and Kaohsiung’s forked 85 Sky Tower. The supplied reference is a logo, so identity was checked against the article and identified source photographs.
notes: Six distinct photographs downloaded, decoded, measured and visually checked; all exceed 2400 pixels on the long side. Prefer c1 for a portrait crop or c2 for native portrait composition. Base obstructions are noted individually.
